items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: I tell you, if you really want to find out, if you see Peter Booker, he can tell more about me.

ctx.x: Well, cut it off for a second.
How many bands they have? They must have had about four or five bands. I tell you, if you really want to find out, if you see Peter Booker, he can tell more about me.
